questions.q: What is Schema Builder, per this lesson?
options: A visual, drag-and-drop tool inside Salesforce Setup for viewing and editing an org's object model
A SOQL query editor for writing and testing queries
A third-party app not built by Salesforce
A reporting tool for building dashboards
questions.explain: Schema Builder is Salesforce's own Setup tool for visualizing and editing the object model.

questions.q: In a Schema Builder object card, how is a relationship field's type displayed?
options: Labeled directly in the field-type column, e.g. Lookup(Account) or Master-Detail(Property)
It isn't shown at all -- you have to open each field individually to check
As a color with no text label
Only as a generic 'Relationship' label with no further detail
questions.explain: Schema Builder labels relationship fields with both the type and the target object, e.g. Master-Detail(Property).

questions.q: As an analyst (not an admin), what does this lesson say you actually need to do with Schema Builder?
options: Read it -- see how objects connect and understand the data's shape before querying, not build new objects in it
Use it to write and execute SOQL queries directly
Use it exclusively to delete unwanted objects
Nothing -- analysts have no legitimate use for Schema Builder
questions.explain: The lesson is explicit: analysts read Schema Builder for orientation, they don't need its object-building features.

questions.q: Per this lesson, what real time-saving benefit does Schema Builder offer before writing SOQL in an unfamiliar org?
options: It answers which objects connect, whether links are Lookup or Master-Detail, and whether a junction object sits between two objects -- in minutes instead of trial and error
It automatically writes correct SOQL queries for you
It eliminates the need to ever learn SOQL
It has no real benefit over guessing at field names
questions.explain: A quick look at Schema Builder answers exactly the questions an analyst would otherwise discover the hard way.

questions.q: In the real screenshot shown in this lesson, what relationship types are labeled on the Cookie Scent object's fields?
options: Master-Detail(Property) and Lookup(User)
Only Lookup relationships, no Master-Detail
Only Master-Detail relationships, no Lookup
A many-to-many relationship type labeled directly on one field
questions.explain: The screenshot shows a Property field labeled Master-Detail(Property) and Owner/Created By fields labeled Lookup(User).
